title: Conditional coordinate sweeps and analytic transfer
summary: For coordinate sweeps with near-uniform line laws and line sizes among powers of two in a suitable fixed interval, we prove a Schatten-moment bound after conditioning on any feasible collection of prescribed card trajectories. An analytic transfer to binary sweeps then shows that a fixed number of sweeps mixes the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards in $`O(d)`$ physical steps, matching the order of the support lower bound.
family_title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

review.reason: Proves Schatten-moment bounds for conditioned coordinate sweeps and mixing of the Thorp shuffle.
